posts.title: Discounted AI tools for nonprofits, and the one form that gates them all
posts.description: Nonprofit pricing for AI has settled. A year ago every lab had a different answer, and most of them were “email sales.” Today Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google all publish a nonprofit rate, and the rate is roughly 75 percent off or free. Microsoft publishes one too, at 15 percent, which is its own kind of answer.

posts.title: Where AI actually saves time in nonprofit ops
posts.description: A common question from ops teams in the church and nonprofit space lately: “We bought a couple of AI tools last year. The vendor demo was great. Six months in we still cannot point at what AI actually did. Are we doing this wrong, or is the technology overhyped?”

posts.title: Openclaw on Oracle’s Free Tier: Always-On AI for $0/month
posts.description: I wasn’t about to spend $1,500 on a new Mac mini just to try out Openclaw (formerly Moltbot/Clawdbot), but I knew I wanted an always-on AI agent. Something that wouldn’t forget context when I closed my laptop, that I could access from my phone via Telegram, and that could actually do things—check email, manage files, run scripts.
